subject: Post-demo: ownership & signoff chain request for Bluewave pilot
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@bluewave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: ownership & signoff chain request for Bluewave pilot

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for your time on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: demo of Redwood inference runtime, expected token-cost profile, and pilot scope (100k tokens/day, 3-week trial).
- Asks: to move toward procurement and security review, can you share the appropriate owners for the following?
  • Economic buyer / budget approver
  • Security/compliance contact for SOC 2 and endpoint controls
  • Procurement/contact who manages standard SOWs and PO processes

Attachments: demo-recording.mp4 (recording), screenshots showing the pilot config.

If you can share a simple org chart (or names/emails), we will map an outreach plan and draft a concise mutual action plan. Ideally we schedule a 30-min sync with security + procurement early next week.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0126
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@bluewave.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@bluewave.com>, Priya Varma <p.varma@bluewave.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: ownership & signoff chain request for Bluewave pilot

Soojin,

Good demo — thanks. Quick answers below and I've attached our org chart.

- Economic buyer: Maya Reddy (CPO) — maya.reddy@bluewave.com
- Procurement: Tom Ellis — tom.ellis@bluewave.com (cc'd)
- Security/Compliance: Priya Varma — p.varma@bluewave.com (cc'd)

Attachment: Bluewave_org_chart_v2.pdf

We'll need a short one-pager on pilot scope + a high-level SOW to share with procurement. Also please include the SOC 2 evidence or a location where we can access it for their review.

Available for a quick intro call Thursday afternoon if that works.

Thanks,
Alex
